notes: where goes to the waw as the connective the ASV wrote for it, and the presentative there was joins שָׁם as the clause's adverbial anchor (rules 14, 20); the ASV writes two words for two morphemes and neither is a surplus.
The article on הָעֲגָלָה takes the the standing before its own word, the construct עֲצֵי taking a supplied one, because the ASV renders this rectum arthrously (rule 29).
